verdict: STORY ACCEPTED, PRODUCTION BLOCKED: no bored window and no structural story fault; the gate stops at the missing editorial contract (EG-01) and one unsupported claim (C-01). Fix TFZ-01 and TFZ-02, send back for a new review.

factual_reliability.evidence: Opened 2026-10-20: C-05 holds (biography.com: 'In 1999, Belfort pleaded guilty to securities fraud and money laundering ... served 22 months'). C-03 only partly: abi.org says Trump 'has reportedly filed for business bankruptcy at least four times', the spoken S05 L7 'six times' rests on logicallyfacts.com, which would not open (proxy 502). C-01 NOT supported: S10 L13 'He slept in one once ... with Kim' vs the cited thefamouspeople.com page, which has 'insolvent in 1985', 'penniless and homeless', spouse Kim, and no car or Toyota (en.wikipedia raw also has none). C-02 unverified: insideevs 403, cleantechnica Cloudflare block. Everything else is declared invented in claim_map.md.

First laugh by ~0:15 (S01 L3 'fixes his tie in the black screen of his phone'). Only L1 (15 words) is pure set-up (BP-05, passes in spirit).

Abstract lines have no picture: S03 L5-L6, S06 L9, S16 L2-L3. Judged on instructions, no picture exists yet.

(0.8 s hold) -> S09 dread -> S10 quiet comedy -> S11 fire -> S12 climax (about 9:36-10:27 est.) -> S13 warmth -> S14 laughs -> S15 twist (12:26). Midpoint S08 falls at 46-50 % (ST-12 passes). findings.consequence: Viewers from SH09 / SH10 meet the long video's ending first; SH03 repeats the error the v1 review fixed in the title.
findings.fix: Shorts: end SH09 on 'Nine offered. One man read to the last line and said no.' (a cliffhanger) and SH10 on the ranking before the verdict; change SH03's hook to 'ruined titan' or 'ruined tycoon'.

BP-09: first laugh at ~0:15, inside 45 s. S04-S05 pack more than one verbal joke per 60 s; the jokes grow from the people and sit beside the facts, so this is the creator's taste, not a finding.

The two accepted creator options stand: S10 (Kiyosaki refuses the seat, 'I'm not a lesson. I teach them.') makes his defeat a choice and mirrors Belfort's refusal at S12; S14 (Trump airs the report, Bezos sees it) joins the two lines. Neither is re-raised; only the report's origin (TFZ-05) is.
